about: Loop rules, recorded from src/runner/execution/loops/*.mjs. `cases` are plain functions ({ id, fn, args, expected }). `runs` play a loop with a table of answers: each role call is answered by results["<seat>/<round or 1>"], the n-th verify call by verify[n]; expected holds the loop result and the calls in order (a verify call is { verify: true }; a call lists the seat id, the objective it was told, and the optional round, preferIndependentOf, independentOf, inputs as { seat, round, outcome } and the size of its batch). `history` cases are patternHistoryOutcome calls.
